subject: Alternative route for the site visit
text: We need to rethink the vendor walk-through on Thursday morning. The maintenance crew blocked the loading dock again, and our safety officer has flagged the area until noon. Since the original route will waste too much time, could you arrive at the side entrance instead? We can meet near the old print room and walk directly through the east wing. That should keep the visit useful without crossing the restricted zone. I’m sorry for the short notice, but this change preserves the checklist and lets us finish before the afternoon shift change.
